music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by the rhythmic beating of the Geta Bera drum and the metallic punctuation of the Thalampataa cymbals, accompanying vocal poetry that narrates the movements of the dancer.

teaching.level_notes: Mastery of all eighteen Vannam is required before a dancer is eligible for the ves costume.
